title: SWPC SUMX01: X2.1 Flare Summary (R3)

fields.headline: X-ray Event exceeded X1

potentialImpacts.heading: Area of Impact
potentialImpacts.text: Large portions of the sunlit side of Earth, strongest at the sub-solar point.

potentialImpacts.heading: Radio
potentialImpacts.text: Wide area blackout of HF radio communication for about an hour.

fields.footer: *** EXERCISE *** Exercise product. Not an official NOAA message.

instructorNote: This is a noise inject. Hand the page to the CRSS and RE along with a Harbor Terminal forward titled "RADIO BLACKOUT R3 — do we need to do anything?" and two EMS alarm lines: "02:31:40 CDT IRON_RANGE_AT2_GIC_NEUT COMM FAIL — RTU poll missed" and "02:31:50 CDT IRON_RANGE_AT2_GIC_NEUT RTN NORMAL 0.4 A". Watch whether they log the summary as Monday evening's flare that is already over and is not a new NGDOP trigger, answer the Harbor Terminal over the hotline, treat the one missed 10-second poll as a communications blip, confirm all 9 GIC monitors report and open a ticket on the RTU, all without raising the condition.
